title: Train of Thought (working name)
bible: Three friends in bright everyday places (a moving train first; office meeting room and BBQ later). Mitch (Australian) is the Chaos One: relaxed, reckless, pitches the bad ideas, never worried. Ollie (English) is the Overthinker: polite, apologetic, panics about every idea. Mitch and Ollie are the double act. Maya is the Deadpan who lands the thought: few words, undercuts the boys, and gets the last line that leaves the viewer thinking, then a one-second hold and a loop. 20-28 s, 9-11 lines under 12 words, mid-conversation at frame 0. Who is at fault rotates. The team writes or approves the final jokes. Planning: planning/2026-11-10-relatable-four-channel/. Episode format, beat map, packaging and multi-part rules: skills/crew-episode/SKILL.md.
